title: Decent sync, but buggy and unintuitive UI
body:
The Good:
- The menu bar app is simple yet intuitive: it's a list of habits and their reminder times, which can easily be checked off
- Sync between devices seems to be quite decent (so far)
- 1 purchase works for all devices

The Bad:
- No summary view for visualizing all habit chains
- No way to quickly see all habits and their reminder time in the main app window, making it difficult to schedule habit times and reorder them
- Having to open the Manage Habits popup just to reorder habits and assign habits to Areas is unintuitive
- Some features look like stubs that aren't working yet (ex. Show Toolbar/Customize Toolbar menu buttons do nothing, Time of Day customization doesn't work)
- Numerous minor bugs, like when reordering habits in the Manage Habits screen
